answer: A Trump Account is a type of traditional IRA established for an eligible child. It is held in the child’s name, while a parent or guardian acts as custodian until the child turns 18. Trump Accounts also have special rules for contributions, investments, distributions, and reporting; after age 18, traditional IRA rules generally apply.
